component.name: AK820 Studio
component.summary: Screen studio for the AJAZZ / Epomaker AK820 Pro keyboard

description.p: Put GIFs, images, video, text, drawings and procedural animations on the 0.85 inch 128×128 screen of the AJAZZ / Epomaker AK820 Pro, and keep the keyboard clock in sync with your computer automatically.
Talks to the keyboard directly over USB (hidraw). No vendor driver, no browser. The protocol was recovered by the ak820-screen project.
